title: Ariane 501: requalify reused assumptions
focus: A reused component brings an operating envelope and inactive-looking functions that still require explicit disposition.

sources.title: Ariane 501 — Presentation of Inquiry Board report
sources.locator: Inquiry findings paragraphs on inertial systems, alignment function, and testing
sources.limitations: ESA’s contemporaneous summary was inspected; the full inquiry report is not the evidence used here. Numeric conversion details are deliberately not reconstructed.

facts.statement: ESA reported simultaneous failure of both inertial reference systems and loss of guidance information during the initial flight.
An alignment function needed before launch remained active afterward; testing did not sufficiently represent the complete flight-control system and its operating context.
facts.locator: Inquiry findings on alignment function and simulations

retrospective.boundary: Inherited inertial software, flight trajectory, redundancy, diagnostics, guidance consumers, and integrated qualification form the reuse boundary.
interfaces: New mission envelope → reused software: inherited validity assumptions need comparison with new trajectories.
Inertial system → guidance: failure indications must not become plausible control inputs.

decision.question: What is the acceptance basis for a component already used successfully elsewhere?
options: Accept previous flight history as sufficient.
Compare old and new envelopes, remove or justify unused functions, and qualify integrated behavior.
decision.recommendation: Make every inherited assumption either demonstrated, changed, or explicitly unresolved.
decision.uncertainty: A software-only test cannot establish complete vehicle behavior; this gallery does not reproduce the original flight dynamics.

rows: List new inputs and modes outside prior experience
Justify post-transition execution or disable it
Identify common software and input dependencies

questions: Why can two redundant units fail together?
Which evidence from the earlier system transfers, and which must be renewed?
Explain a reuse qualification gap without describing all legacy software as unsafe.
answer_signals: Tests assumptions rather than relying on the component name or reputation.
Connects common inputs and code to correlated failure.
Defines a bounded acceptance claim and unresolved integration evidence.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: reuse a navigation service on a faster vehicle. Create three assumption-delta entries before choosing tests.
retrospective.limits: The artifact is a teaching synthesis of an official summary, not the original inquiry’s complete causal analysis.
